criterion: Repeated template actions identify their target
description: The loop template gallery exposed multiple buttons with the same accessible name, `Use this template`, making template selection ambiguous for keyboard and assistive-technology users.
expected: Each template action should include the template name, such as `Use Review to issues template` or `Use Backlog -> PR template`.
actual: Every visible template action was announced as `Use this template`.
suggested_fix: Add target-specific accessible labels to each template action while preserving concise visible copy.
